ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low; dominated by low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels localized primarily at the distal tips and scattered along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous solid dark-grey to black region across >95% of the visible surface. High-contrast white pixel clusters are mapped to the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Minor punctate white speckling is visible in the lower-central quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow U-shaped central depression with a calculated wide-angle convergence (estimated >120 degrees) and minimal bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration pattern with distinct peaks and valleys; higher frequency of smaller serrations on the left lobe and more pronounced, larger peaks on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve along the trailing edge from the distal tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detected high-contrast white circular pixel clusters at the distal-most tips of both left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the right lobe medial surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white scarring and tissue loss at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
